# Quickstart

Source: <https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/quickstart>

This guide takes you from your API key to a filled order in five requests. The sandbox has the same endpoints as the live API, but it has its own host and keys, uses test money, and doesn't connect to the exchange.

## Before you begin

The sandbox is at `https://gateway-sandbox.matambaintelligence.com`. The live host comes with your live keys.

When we set up your [sandbox access](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/support), we send you a sandbox API key and two account codes: one to trade with, and one ending in `99` that has a zero balance, so you can test a rejected order.

The examples use these placeholders:

| Placeholder | Replace with |
|---|---|
| `$HOST` | The sandbox's host, as above, without `https://` |
| `$KEY` | Your sandbox API key |
| `$ACCOUNT` | The account you trade with |
| `$ACCOUNT_99` | The account ending in `99` |
| `$ORDER_ID` | The `id` returned when you place the order in step 3 |

Each step shows the request, and a `curl` command that sends it. The commands read the placeholders as shell variables, so set them once, such as `KEY=mgw_test_...`, and each command runs as written.

Send every request with the `Authorization: Bearer $KEY` header. Request and response bodies are JSON. Amounts are integers in kobo, so ₦475.00 is `47500`, and a field ending in `_kobo_decimal` is a decimal string of kobo.

## Place your first order

**List your accounts**

Confirm that your key works and see which accounts you can trade for.

```http Request
GET /v1/accounts
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
```

```bash cURL
curl https://$HOST/v1/accounts \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
```

```http Response
HTTP/1.1 200 OK

{
  "object": "list",
  "has_more": false,
  "next_cursor": null,
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "account",
      "code": "$ACCOUNT",
      "application": null,
      "created_at": "2026-09-25T06:00:00Z"
    },
    {
      "object": "account",
      "code": "$ACCOUNT_99",
      "application": null,
      "created_at": "2026-09-25T06:00:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Estimate the cost**

Get an estimate before you place the order. An estimate doesn't place or store anything.

```http Request
POST /v1/orders/estimate
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "account": "$ACCOUNT",
  "symbol": "DANGCEM",
  "side": "buy",
  "quantity": 10,
  "type": "market",
  "time_in_force": "day"
}
```

```bash cURL
curl -X POST https://$HOST/v1/orders/estimate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @- <<EOF
{
  "account": "$ACCOUNT",
  "symbol": "DANGCEM",
  "side": "buy",
  "quantity": 10,
  "type": "market",
  "time_in_force": "day"
}
EOF
```

```http Response
HTTP/1.1 200 OK

{
  "object": "order_estimate",
  "account": "$ACCOUNT",
  "symbol": "DANGCEM",
  "side": "buy",
  "quantity": 10,
  "type": "market",
  "time_in_force": "day",
  "price_kobo": null,
  "estimated_total_kobo": 530338,
  "estimated_total_kobo_decimal": "530337.5"
}
```

A market order is priced at the day's price limit: the upper limit for a buy, the lower limit for a sell. In the sandbox, the limits are 10% either side of the listed price, and charges are a flat 1.5%. This estimate works out as follows:

| | Kobo |
|---|---|
| Upper price limit: ₦475.00 plus 10% | `52250` |
| 10 shares at the upper limit: 10 × 52250 | `522500` |
| Plus 1.5% charges: 522500 × 1.015 = 530337.5, exact in `estimated_total_kobo_decimal` | `530337.5` |
| `estimated_total_kobo`: rounded up to the whole kobo | `530338` |

The sandbox then fills the order at ₦475.00, so the account pays `482125` kobo: 10 × 47500, plus 1.5%. A sell estimate is priced at the lower limit and is what you'd receive after charges. In live, the estimate is the broker's figure: it includes the consideration, statutory charges and commission, and it's indicative.

**Place the order**

> **Tip.**
> Use a unique `Idempotency-Key` for each order. If a request times out, retry it with the same key and you'll get the original order back instead of a duplicate. Each run of this guide needs a new key, such as `my-first-order-2`: sent again, `my-first-order` returns your first order with `200 OK`, and with a different order `409 duplicate_order`.

```http Request
POST /v1/orders
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
Content-Type: application/json
Idempotency-Key: my-first-order

{
  "account": "$ACCOUNT",
  "symbol": "DANGCEM",
  "side": "buy",
  "quantity": 10,
  "type": "market",
  "time_in_force": "day"
}
```

```bash cURL
curl -X POST https://$HOST/v1/orders \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: my-first-order" \
  --data-binary @- <<EOF
{
  "account": "$ACCOUNT",
  "symbol": "DANGCEM",
  "side": "buy",
  "quantity": 10,
  "type": "market",
  "time_in_force": "day"
}
EOF
```

```http Response
HTTP/1.1 201 Created

{
  "object": "order",
  "id": "ord_62jxryztxctob7uopekg",
  "account": "$ACCOUNT",
  "symbol": "DANGCEM",
  "side": "buy",
  "quantity": 10,
  "type": "market",
  "time_in_force": "day",
  "price_kobo": null,
  "state": "pending",
  "exchange_order_id": "1790316754123",
  "filled_quantity": 0,
  "reason": null,
  "reject_reason": null,
  "created_at": "2026-09-25T06:12:34Z",
  "updated_at": "2026-09-25T06:12:34Z",
  "filled_at": null,
  "average_fill_price_kobo_decimal": null,
  "client_reference": null
}
```

The `pending` state means the order is open at the exchange.

To see a rejected order, place the same order on `$ACCOUNT_99` with a new key. It returns `422 order_rejected` with `reject_reason` `insufficient_funds`.

**Check the order status**

The sandbox fills market orders immediately. We check the broker for fills about every 30 seconds. If you've registered a webhook endpoint, we send it an `order.filled` [event](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/webhooks). Either way, the event is in `GET /v1/events`. Wait 30 seconds, then retrieve the order. If it still reads `pending`, retrieve it again a few seconds later.

```http Request
GET /v1/orders/$ORDER_ID
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
```

```bash cURL
curl https://$HOST/v1/orders/$ORDER_ID \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
```

```http Response
HTTP/1.1 200 OK

{
  "object": "order",
  "id": "ord_62jxryztxctob7uopekg",
  "account": "$ACCOUNT",
  "symbol": "DANGCEM",
  "side": "buy",
  "quantity": 10,
  "type": "market",
  "time_in_force": "day",
  "price_kobo": null,
  "state": "filled",
  "exchange_order_id": "1790316754123",
  "filled_quantity": 10,
  "reason": null,
  "reject_reason": null,
  "created_at": "2026-09-25T06:12:34Z",
  "updated_at": "2026-09-25T06:13:02Z",
  "filled_at": "2026-09-25T06:13:02Z",
  "average_fill_price_kobo_decimal": "47500",
  "client_reference": null
}
```

**View the position**

The filled order now appears as a position on the account.

```http Request
GET /v1/accounts/$ACCOUNT/positions
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
```

```bash cURL
curl https://$HOST/v1/accounts/$ACCOUNT/positions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
```

```http Response
HTTP/1.1 200 OK

{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "position",
      "symbol": "DANGCEM",
      "name": "DANGCEM",
      "quantity": 10,
      "average_cost_kobo_decimal": "47500",
      "market_price_kobo": 47500,
      "market_value_kobo": 475000,
      "asset_class": "Stock",
      "sector": null,
      "industry": null
    }
  ],
  "has_more": false,
  "next_cursor": null
}
```

The order is filled and the position shows it. Every endpoint is in the API reference, and every error code in the [error reference](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/errors).

## Run this guide in Postman

Import the [Postman collection](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/matamba-gateway.postman_collection.json) and the [sandbox environment](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/matamba-gateway.sandbox.postman_environment.json), then fill in `api_key`, `account` and `account_99` in the environment. Its `base_url` is already the sandbox's address. The collection runs these five requests in order, then requests for common errors. It refuses to run with anything but a sandbox key.

To generate a client in your own language, use the [OpenAPI file](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/openapi.json).

## Rehearse errors and rare outcomes

The [sandbox reference](https://docs.matambaintelligence.com/sandbox) lists how the sandbox behaves, a request for each error it can show, and the test values that make rare outcomes happen on demand.
